text:
erin: quick flag - noticed docs example for tenant burst-protection under dedicated/provisioning is still using `burst_threshold_pct` (old field) which the runtime ignores; result: tenants get excess replicas during short spikes
josh: oof. which page / snippet?
erin: examples/provisioning/tenant-burst.yaml in the migration guide, linked from the reserved-pools section. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5342 - i pushed an edit but sims show different behavior
kat: can you paste the doc snippet and the sim command you used?
erin: sim command: `./dev-tools/sim-burst --config examples/provisioning/tenant-burst.yaml --runs 100 --seed 7`
erin: current snippet in docs:
```yaml
tenant:
  name: reporting-tenant
  reserved_pool: true
  burst_threshold_pct: 150
  max_burst_replicas: 20
  labels:
    - region: us-west1
```
runtime-bot: FYI runtime schema expects `burst_control` object with `threshold_percent` and `max_replicas` and `cooldown_seconds`; old flat keys are ignored by parser
josh: ah that would cause the sim to behave like unlimited burst, explains overshoot
kat: propose: 1) update YAML examples to runtime schema, 2) add a one-line migration mapping table, 3) add a Node SDK snippet (we've got Python/Go elsewhere)
erin: drafted corrected YAML in PR branch:
```yaml
tenant:
  name: reporting-tenant
  reserved_pool: true
  burst_control:
    threshold_percent: 150
    max_replicas: 20
    cooldown_seconds: 60
  isolation_decorators:
    - region: us-west1
```
josh: nice. for the migration blurb suggest: "Map old keys: `burst_threshold_pct` -> `burst_control.threshold_percent`; `max_burst_replicas` -> `burst_control.max_replicas`; prefer isolation_decorators over labels for scheduling."
kat: adding Node snippet now. please include codeblock language tag so CI doesn't flake
erin: Node snippet draft:
```javascript
// examples: node SDK usage
const { Dedicated } = require('@redwood/dedicated');
const client = new Dedicated.Client();
await client.createTenant({
  name: 'reporting-tenant',
  reservedPool: true,
  burstControl: { thresholdPercent: 150, maxReplicas: 20, cooldownSeconds: 60 },
  isolationDecorators: [{ region: 'us-west1' }]
});
```
docs-ci: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/tenant-burst-migrate-5342
docs-ci: linkcheck: /docs/dedicated#reserved-pools anchor valid; docs-lint: codeblock missing language tag on the YAML example (please add `yaml`)
josh: i'll push a tiny fix to the branch adding ```yaml to the example and a one-line migration table. also adding a quick unit-parser test that validates examples/ against runtime schema so these regressions fail fast
erin: added test ref in PR description and pinged @kat for quick review. thanks for the catch everyone :rocket:
